producer_preservation_audit.create_producer_semantics: The producer parses a response only after HTTP 200 or 201, then persists selected order fields. The persisted row does not distinguish HTTP 200 from HTTP 201 and is not the raw response body.
producer_preservation_audit.cancel_producer_semantics: The producer reduces HTTP 200 or 204 to Boolean true before logging. The persisted row contains no HTTP status, response body, reduced_by/count or exchange timestamp.
